text: 据初步航运数据和贸易消息人士，俄罗斯8月将通过船对船转运从亚洲进口近27万吨成品油，以缓解乌克兰袭击其炼油厂造成的燃料短缺。俄罗斯通常是燃料净出口国，但在过去数月乌克兰持续袭击其能源设施导致炼油产量下降、全国范围出现燃料短缺后，被迫转向进口。根据数据和消息人士透露，俄罗斯8月从亚洲进口的近27万吨成品油中约三分之一来自印度，其余在韩国和马来西亚等国沿海装载。这些由贸易商安排的货物在油轮之间转移，很可能是为了掩盖来源和航线，因与俄罗斯的贸易可能引发西方制裁。数据显示7月没有此类货物运抵俄罗斯。根据船舶追踪机构Vortexa和Kpler的数据以及贸易消息人士
text_en: According to preliminary shipping data and trade sources, Russia will import nearly 270,000 metric tons of refined oil products from Asia via ship-to-ship transfers in August to ease fuel shortages caused by Ukrainian strikes on its refineries. Russia, typically a net fuel exporter, has turned to imports after months of Ukrainian attacks on its energy facilities reduced refining output and triggered nationwide shortages. About one-third of the August imports from Asia come from India, with the rest loaded off South Korea and Malaysia, according to data and sources. The cargoes, arranged by traders, are transferred between tankers, likely to conceal origin and route as trade with Russia could trigger Western sanctions. Data shows no such shipments arrived in July, based on vessel tracking from Vortexa and Kpler and trade sources.
